links.effect: Random forest 91.10% accuracy/78.69% F1; feature MLP 89.73% accuracy/78.26% F1.
links.quote: Using a stratified subset of 584 recordings, a random forest achieved 91.10% binary accuracy and 78.69% F1-score for asthma-vs-non-asthma screening, while a feature-based multilayer perceptron achieved 89.73% accuracy and 78.26% F1-score.
